description: This file defines the MessageSource class used within the Apache Fineract project. It encapsulates a 'source' string representing the origin of a message in the external service messaging domain.

classes.name: MessageSource
classes.description: A class representing the source of a message in the messaging domain, with a single non-null source string.

methods.name: MessageSource
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the source field with a non-null string.
